_about: Phase 6 task-accuracy set. Every answer is checked mechanically by 03_task_accuracy.py - no judgement calls. Arithmetic answers are verified by the script's --check-answers mode.

suffix.arithmetic: Show your working briefly, then end with a final line of the form 'Answer: <number>'.
